translation: Flavor bitter, neutral, non-toxic. It mainly nourishes spleen qi, settles the five viscera, harmonizes the center, treats diarrhea and dysentery and intestinal [disease] in adults and children, downflow of pus and blood, removes white worms and jaundice [黃膽], and abscesses and worms. Taken over a long time, it lightens the body and prolongs life.
